rv.q: Yet this straight musical retread through the Burt Bacharach songbook shows how well the genre can work.
Riabko adds almost nothing to it with these new settings that are allegedly creating a fresh generation of fans.
It is therefore an absolute pleasure to see his music so thrillingly and modernly re-imagined in ‘Close to You: Bacharach Reimagined’ at the Criterion Theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise this thrilling modern reimagining of Burt Bacharach's legendary catalogue, celebrating its innovative jazz rhythms and joyous energy that transforms the iconic composer's work for contemporary audiences.
